 Pacesetting. Passionate. Together. HELLA, one of the leading automotive suppliers worldwide, has shaped the industry with innovative lighting systems and vehicle electronics. Every day, 36,000 employees worldwide are committed to this with passion, know-how and innovative strength.
 YOUR TASKS
 You will be working within HELLA Romania Design and Development Center for Energy Management - DCDC department 
 You will be involved in creating automotive components for 48V mild hybrid systems 
 Estimate, plan and track tasks within international teams 
 Create specifications, design and implement complex software components for e-mobility automotive systems: Development of energy transfer electronics control 
 Ensure quality processes, as requested by automotive standards 
 Your Qualifications
 You will have completed studies in a relevant specialization like Automatics, Electronics, Informatics 
 Very good knowledge of C, with relevant experience in embedded systems and knowledge of software development processes 
 Power electronics knowledge is a plus 
 5 years+ experience with Model-Based Design using MATLAB/Simulink & Stateflow 
 5 years+ experience with Embedded Coder for microcontroller targets 
 Strong hardware know-how, and extensive MIL/SIL/HIL experience 
 Low level debug skills, Oscilloscope measuring 
 Good knowledge of English 
 Take the opportunity to reveal your potential within a global, family-run company that offers you the best possible conditions for progressing in your career.
